messages:
Priya (growth): quick sync - launch checklist for next week's product release + tied webinar. need redirects, schema for replay, and inbound lead routing. who can own what?
Leo (seo): I can own redirects + microdata. Can we confirm final landing slug? options: /launch/scale-inference-2026 or /webinars/scale-inference-2026
Cam (content): prefer /launch/scale-inference-2026 for posts and /webinars/... for the event hub. link both but canonical -> launch page for SEO.
Riley (ops): ok. i'll create a redirect plan from legacy slugs and temporary promotional paths. will publish 301s for any promo shortlinks after verification.
Priya (growth): also need keyword anchors for the three posts: "throughput-optimized serving", "quantized GPU inference", "predictable inference costs". Cam can you blend those into headers and CTAs?
Cam (content): yes. will swap some "learn more" anchors to descriptive anchors like "why quantized GPU inference matters" and "predictable inference costs explained". will stage changes in CMS.
Leo (seo): mapping rules: posts -> pillar `/solutions/inference-economics`, webinar replay -> `/resources/webinars/scale-inference-2026/replay`. I'll attach a small schema snippet for the replay page (Event + VideoObject + potential Transcript).
CrawlBot: quick-audit: found 8 URLs with 302s, 3 missing structured data on replay pages, 2 pages with duplicate meta descriptions. report: https://redwood.ai/internal/seo/audit/2149994321
Riley (ops): I'll share a CSV for redirects in this format: `from,to,response,notes` - example row: `/promo/scale` , `/launch/scale-inference-2026`, `301`, `promo shortlink -> canonical`. ETA 4pm today.
Priya (growth): good. also UTM rules: webinars should map to SDR queue B if utm_medium=email and utm_campaign contains "scale_launch". Posts should route to product-nurture. Riley, can you push rules to HubSpot?
Riley (ops): yes. example mapping i'll apply:
```
utm_campaign contains "scale_launch" & utm_medium == "email" -> queue: sdr-b
utm_source == "partner" -> queue: partner-nurture
utm_campaign == "organicsocial" -> queue: marketing-nurture
```
I'll attach the full mapping once live.
Cam (content): schema snippet for replay page (paste):
```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Serving at Scale",
  "startDate": "2026-06-02T18:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-06-02T19:30:00Z",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation","url": "https://redwood.ai/webinars/scale-inference-2026"},
  "performer": [{"@type":"Person","name":"Priya Rao"},{"@type":"Person","name":"Marcus Chen"}],
  "workExample": {"@type":"VideoObject","name":"Scale inference webinar replay","url":"https://redwood.ai/resources/webinars/scale-inference-2026/replay","duration":"PT45M"}
}
```
Leo (seo): nice. Add `transcript` property on the VideoObject when transcript is available. Also add `schema:audience` for developer role to help targeting.
Cam (content): will add transcript and audience tags post-publish.
Riley (ops): redirect CSV ready: I'll drop in the shared drive and tag the CMS release. Minor note: we have two legacy vanity domains to map (`redwood-ai.co/scale` and `rwd.ai/scale`) -> both to /launch/scale-inference-2026 with 301.
Priya (growth): excellent. final checklist: 1) redirect CSV applied, 2) schema inserted on replay, 3) UTM->queue rules live, 4) internal link anchor variations applied, 5) preflight crawl. Deadline: tomorrow noon.
Leo (seo): i'll run preflight crawl after redirects go live and post any failures (duplicate titles, meta issues).
CrawlBot: scheduled preflight crawl -> run at 2026-06-01T08:00:00Z.
Riley (ops): sharing redirect CSV now: https://redwood.ai/internal/ops/redirects/2149994321.csv
Cam (content): staging updates queued for tomorrow AM.
Priya (growth): thanks all. i'll send the release checklist and a short brief for partners with final shortlinks. :sparkles:
